resolution.note: driver flags partial/blocked reports with no changes and no command+exit blocker

title: Driver flags a partial report with no changes and a non-technical blocker
body: Outcome: when a worker turn reports partial or blocked with empty changed_paths and no blocker naming a command and its exit code, krn worker start/send print 'blocker not technical: send a continuation' and record it in result.json, so the lead does not read the rollout. Evidence: PR #193 round 1, gpt-6-luna stopped after 24 s and 3 reads claiming no time left although the prompt says no time limit (.krn/runs/lead/verify-observer/rounds/001/report.json). Proof: new observer under test/worker/ red at base by assertion.
